questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests a high-stakes, real-time system with multi-city data isolation, cross-service state, and network resiliency; emphasizes determinism via seeded data and time control; demonstrates tooling choices and verification strategies across UI, API, and event streams.

## Key Concepts
- Real-time cross-service end-to-end testing
- Multi-tenant data isolation and partitioned state
- Event-driven consistency, time freezing, deterministic seeds
- Load and network partition scenarios across services
- Observability and verifications across auth, booking, driver, map, payments

## Code Example
```javascript
// Pseudo-test harness: spawnRides
async function spawnRides(n, cities) {
  // create n rides across given cities with seeded data
  // enqueue requests, simulate driver replies, collect results
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you scale this to 10k concurrent rides?
- How would you test partial map outages without affecting live traffic?
